AGENDA
  GLENDALE ARTS AND CULTURE COMMISSION
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor
  Glendale, CA 91206
Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-
verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the City webpage,
glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, Amazon Fire, iOS and
Android devices using a free app called Cablecast and choosing "Glendale TV" from the menu.
Meetings are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas.
Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. For public comments and questions during the
meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public comments on a specific agenda item will be taken when that
agenda item is discussed. If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for
assistance, please contact the City Clerk at (818) 548-2090 during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. The City Clerk’ office should be notified 72 hours (three
business days) or as soon as practicable for requests regarding sign language translation and
Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are
received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will be available for review
in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E. Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting or as soon as
practicable. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City
provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak
in their native language.

CITY OF GLENDALE
  ARTS and CULTURE COMMISSION
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Thursday, September 19, 2024, at 10:00 a.m.
1. ROLL CALL
  •  The meeting was called to order on September 19, 2024, at 10:02 a.m.
  •  Present: Vice Chair Yank, Commissioners Tufenkian Zadorian, Aleksandryan, Pogosian, Chairperson
  Vidor
  The Agenda for the September 19, 2024, Regular Meeting was posted on September 16, 2024, on
  the Bulletin Board outside City Hall.

2. CONSENT ITEMS (Including Minutes)
  The following are routine and may be acted upon by one motion. Any member of the
  Commission or the audience requesting separate consideration may do so by making such
  request before motion is proposed.
  a. Minutes of the July 18, 2024 Regular Arts and Culture Commission Meeting

  Moved:  Commissioner Zadorian
  Seconded :  Vice Chair Yank

  Ayes:  Commissioners Vice Chair Yank, Tufenkian, Zadorian, Chairperson Vidor
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  Commissioner Aleksandryan, Pogosian

3. INTRODUCTIONS AND PRESENTATIONS
  a. Danielle Garza, Public Arts Intern
  • Ms. Fukutomi-Jones introduced Danielle Garza as the new Public Arts Intern; Ms. Garza
  introduced herself to the Commission. The Commission welcomed her.
  b. Library, Arts & Culture Events – Presented by Loreto Lopez, Program Coordinator
  • Ms. Loreto Lopez gave an overview of current and upcoming events at Glendale Library, Arts &
  Culture locations.
  • Chair Vidor stated that on October 10th, the Brand Associates will be screening a film titled
  “Neon” at 6:00 p.m.

4. WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS – None

5. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to Items NOT a Part of this Agenda. Each Speaker is Allowed 5 Minutes.
  Members of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission may Question or Respond to the
  Speaker, but there will be no Debate or Decision. The Matter may be Referred to Staff
  Through the Commission Chair for Investigation and Report. – No Speakers

  1
 6. ACTION ITEMS
  a. Palmer Park Basketball Court Mural - Design Concept Proposals
  1. Motion recommending that the City Council authorize the City Manager, or a designee,
  to enter into an Agreement for Commission of Artwork with an artist/artist team to design
  a public art piece for the Fremont Park Column Tile Artwork in an amount not to exceed
  $30,000 dispersed from the Urban Art Program Fund.
  • Ms. Fukutomi-Jones introduced Beau Basse and Catherine Forsyth. LeBasse Projects staff
  provided an overview of the three finalists, and the artists/artist teams presented their design
  concept proposals for the Palmer Park Basketball Court Mural for review and consideration by
  the Commission. The Commission thanked the artists for their presentations, gave their
  feedback and asked questions.

  That the Arts and Culture Commission hereby recommends that the City Council authorize the City
  Manager, or a designee, to enter into an Agreement for Commission of Artwork with an artist/artist team
  to design, fabricate, and install a public art piece for the Palmer Park Basketball Court Mural in an
  amount not to exceed $30,000 dispersed from the Urban Art Program Fund, as more fully outlined in
  the September 19, 2024 Report by the Library, Arts & Culture’s Principal Arts & Culture Administrator:

  First Recommendation:  Tanner Goldbeck, for the artwork entitled, “Palm Trees.”
  Alternate Recommendation: 3B Collective, for the artwork entitled, “Unity Through Play.”

  Moved:  Commissioner Zadorian
  Seconded :  Vice Chair Yank

  Ayes:  Commissioners Vice Chair Yank, Tufenkian, Zadorian, Chairperson Vidor
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  Commissioner Aleksandryan, Pogosian

  b. Glendale International Film Festival - Sponsorship Opportunity
  1. Motion approving (1) the funding of a proposal by Glendale Arts to provide arts
  programming associated with the Glendale International Film Festival from September
  26 – October 1, 2024, and (2) the sponsorship of the Glendale International Film
  Festival, in an amount not to exceed $10,000 from the 2024-2025 Work Plan.
  • Nina Crowe, Chief Executive Officer of Glendale Arts gave a brief presentation of the proposal
  to provide arts programming associated with the Glendale International Film Festival. The
  Commission gave their feedback and asked questions.

  That the Arts and Culture Commission hereby approves (1) the funding of a proposal by Glendale Arts
  to provide programming associated with the Glendale International Film Festival from September 26 –
  October 1, 2024, and (2) the sponsorship of programming in an amount not to exceed $10,000 from the
  2024 – 2025 Work Plan, as more fully outlined in the September 19, 2024 Report by the Library, Arts &
  Culture’s Principal Arts & Culture Administrator.

  Moved:  Commissioner Zadorian
  Seconded :  Commissioner Tufenkian

  Ayes:  Commissioners Vice Chair Yank, Tufenkian, Zadorian, Chairperson Vidor
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  Commissioner Aleksandryan, Pogosian

  2
   c. Artsakh Creative Program – Commissioner Appointment
  1. Motion appointing one Commissioner to the Artsakh Creative Program Selection
  Committee.
  • Ms. Fukutomi-Jones stated that staff along with Community Development department is seeking
  a new Commissioner appointment specifically for the selection committee. The Commission
  gave their feedback and asked questions.

  That the Arts and Culture Commission hereby appoints Ms. Loreto Lopez to represent the
  Commission and to serve on the Artsakh Creative Program Application Review Panel, as more fully
  outlined in the September 19, 2024 Report by the Library, Arts & Culture’s Principal Arts & Culture
  Administrator.

  Moved:  Commissioner Zadorian
  Seconded :  Chairperson Vidor

  Ayes:  Commissioners Vice Chair Yank, Tufenkian, Zadorian, Chairperson Vidor
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  Commissioner Aleksandryan, Pogosian

7. DISCUSSION ITEMS
  a. 2024-2025 Work Plan Progress

a.  CITY WIDE ARTS
i.  Mural Ordinance – Update
  Staff is in the process of finalizing the Mural Ordinance and working with public art law consultant,
  Sarah Odenkirk, on reviewing the final aspects of the ordinance. Staff will present the final draft to the
  Commission for review and feedback. Staff will plan to host a mural ordinance community input meeting
  in Spring 2025 with the goal of adopting the mural ordinance from City Council in Summer 2025.

ii.  Montrose Circular Benches – Update
  Staff is in the process of working with LeBasse Projects and Ms. Rico, “Our Garden Spot” to establish a
  Professional Services Agreement with the goal of installing the artwork by Fall 2025.

b.  NEIGHBORHOOD ARTS – No Update.
c.  PERFORMING ARTS
  Jewel City Concert Series – Update
  On September 25, 2024 at 5:00 PM, the Jewel City Concert Series will kick off with Logan Hone Band.
  The concerts will take place every Saturday through October 26, 2024 at the Artsakh Paseo and are free
  to the public.

d.  ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS
  Getty PST ART: “Blended Worlds” Exhibit – Update
  On September 21, 2024 at 7:00 PM, the Getty PST ART: “Blended Worlds” exhibit will host an opening
  reception at the Brand Library & Art Center. This exhibit is in collaboration with the Jet Propulsion
  Laboratory (JPL) and will run through January 4, 2025.

e.  MARKETING AND COMMUNICATIONS – No Update.

  3
   b. 2023-2024 Student Ex-Officio Commissioners – Acknowledgement
  • The Commission and Staff honored and expressed their gratitude to both Gema Pogosian and
  Edith Aleksandryan and presented them with Certificates of Appreciation for their service to the
  Commission this past year. Commissioner Pogosian and Aleksandryan thanked and expressed
  their gratitude to the Arts and Culture Commissioners, City Council and Mayor of the City for the
  opportunity to work with arts within the city.

8. COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS
  • Vice Chair Yank thanked the Student Commissioners for their work with the Commission and
  acknowledged Ms. Fukutomi-Jones and Arts and Culture staff for their hard work on JPL- Brand
  Library Getty PST ART Collaborative exhibition and highly encouraged to go see exhibition. The
  Commission echoed Vice Chair Yank’s comments.
  • Ms. Fukutomi-Jones stated it was a city-wide effort that included Brand Library staff, City
  Attorney’s office, Parks landscaping department and Public works department just to name a
  few. Ms. Fukutomi-Jones encouraged everyone to attend on Saturday to the opening reception.
  Chair Vidor echoed Ms. Fukutomi-Jones comment.
  • Commissioner Pogosian and Commissioner Aleksandryan once more thanked the Commission
  for the opportunity to be part of the Commission.

9. ADJOURNMENT 11:35 a.m.

  Motion to Adjourn: Commissioner Zadorian.

  The next Regular Meeting of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission is October 17, 2024,
  at 10:00 AM in City Council Chambers – 613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor Glendale, CA 91206.
